newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn, soy and wheat mostly steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn, soy and wheat mostly steady.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf corn, soybean and wheat basis values were mostly steady amid featureless dealings, export sources said.

In export news, Egypt's official Holding Co for Rice and Flour Mills said on Friday it was seeking 150,000 tonnes plus or minus five percent of U.S. hard red wheat or Australian hard wheat for delivery between April and June. Deadline for the bids was March 24.
Also, high waters have forced the U.S. Coast Guard to issue temporary restrictions on barge traffic south from Vicksburg, La.
The number of barges were limited under tow at any given time and deep draft vessels were required to take additional precautions to avoid ramming into levees.
Louisiana officials were scrambling to sandbag weak points in levees as the flood-swollen Mississippi River pushed toward a near-record crest.
Federal officials said the predicted 44-foot crest at Baton Rouge on March 27 would be the highest since 1945, when the river reached 45.18 feet.
